speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: A concurrent or simultaneous debate will allow Members to address both Motions in a single speech and enable the issues raised in the two Motions to be considered holistically.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: It will also allow for more efficient conduct of parliamentary business.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The Clerk will now proceed to read the Notices of Motion.
